claims: Lockheed Martin is the top U.S. federal contractor.
Lockheed Martin primarily serves the U.S. Department of Defense and federal agencies.
Lockheed Martin produces the F-35 Lightning II.
Lockheed Martin produces the F-22 Raptor.
Lockheed Martin produces the C-130 Hercules.
Lockheed Martin’s Aeronautics represents about 39% of 2024 revenue.
Lockheed Martin produces the Orion spacecraft for NASA’s Artemis missions.
Lockheed Martin’s Rotary and Mission Systems combines Sikorsky helicopters with naval systems, radars, and cybersecurity solutions.
Lockheed Martin develops the PAC-3 missiles.
Lockheed Martin’s headquarters is in Bethesda, Maryland.
Approximately 73% of Lockheed Martin’s revenue comes from the U.S. government (2024).
65% of Lockheed Martin’s revenue comes from the Department of Defense (2024).
